## `ot_documents` (`data/ot_documents.parquet`, config `default`)

One row per Other Transaction document (a base award or a modification) that FPDS's public ATOM feed returns for AWARD_TYPE:"OTHER TRANSACTION".

Non-null and non-blank are shares of the table's rows; non-blank also leaves out empty strings.

| column | type | description | non-null | non-blank | example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `first_seen` | string | When ota-watch's daily collection first saw the document in FPDS (UTC, ISO 8601). `baseline` means it was already public when the project started, or was signed before the collection's 400-day window. Not when FPDS published it. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `baseline` |
| `key` | string | Unique document key: `kind\|agency_id\|piid\|mod\|parent_piid` (`mod` is `0` for a base document; order PIIDs repeat across parent IDVs, so the parent is part of the key). Primary key. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `OtherTransactionIDV\|9700\|DAAE300190008\|0\|` |
| `kind` | string | FPDS document type: `OtherTransactionAward` (an agreement, or an order under an OT IDV) or `OtherTransactionIDV` (the parent vehicle). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `OtherTransactionIDV` |
| `action_type` | string | FPDS contractActionType description: `OTHER TRANSACTION AGREEMENT`, `OTHER TRANSACTION ORDER` or `OTHER TRANSACTION IDV`. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `OTHER TRANSACTION IDV` |
| `agency_id` | string | FPDS agencyID of the document's ID (the contracting agency code, e.g. `9700` Defense, `7013` TSA). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `9700` |
| `piid` | string | FPDS PIID: the agreement, order or IDV number. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `DAAE300190008` |
| `mod` | string | FPDS modNumber; `0` for the base document. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `0` |
| `parent_agency_id` | string | Orders only: agencyID of the referenced IDV. | 17.0% | 17.0% | `9700` |
| `parent_piid` | string | Orders only: PIID of the referenced IDV (the vehicle the order is placed under). | 17.0% | 17.0% | `DAAE300190008` |
| `signed` | string | FPDS signedDate, YYYY-MM-DD. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `2000-11-15` |
| `effective` | string | FPDS effectiveDate, YYYY-MM-DD. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `2000-11-15` |
| `completion` | string | FPDS currentCompletionDate, YYYY-MM-DD. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `2010-12-22` |
| `fiscal_year` | string | FPDS fiscalYear of the action, as given. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `2001` |

| `mod_reason` | string | FPDS reasonForModification description (e.g. `FUNDING ONLY ACTION`). Null on base documents (and a few modifications). | 82.4% | 82.4% | `FUNDING ONLY ACTION` |
